# Deploy@EU

> A non-profit community of people who deploy AI and automation inside European companies: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs), in-house builders, consultants, and the business owners who hire them.

## Goal
Help European companies put AI to work by sharing what really happens in deployments: what worked, what it cost, and what failed. At the core are the people who do the deployment work; around them the community connects business owners, newcomers to the field and partners.

## Why it exists
Most AI stories are demos and sales pitches. Honest reports from the field are missing. In Europe the obstacles are specific: old software without an API, GDPR, the EU AI Act, works councils, many languages. Every team hits the same walls alone; the community wants each wall to be hit only once.

## What the community does
- Case library: real deployment cases (the problem, existing systems, what was built, measured results, where it got stuck, what to do differently). Reviewed for consent, privacy, honest numbers and no advertising.
- Walls: recurring obstacles tagged across cases: no-api, legacy-desktop, data-quality, gdpr, ai-act, works-council, change-management, vendor-lock, cost, reliability.
- Interviews with practitioners and business owners.
- Reading sessions every two weeks: one article, one hour, honest discussion.
- Home base for chat and events: Discord (being set up).

## Who it is for
- Practitioners: learn from others' cases and walls, find peers across Europe, build a public, reviewed portfolio under their own name.
- Business owners: see what AI deployments look like at similar companies, with measured numbers and honest failures, before spending money; talk to people who have done it without being sold to.
- Newcomers: a way into the field through real cases, reading sessions and a guided first contribution.
- Partners and sponsors: support a neutral, practitioner-led space; sponsors are credited at the events they support.

## Principles
- Non-profit. No membership fees. The community's own talks and courses are free.
- Money the community receives is used only for the community.
- The community endorses no company, including sponsors and members' own businesses, and takes no commission.
- Honest numbers: measured results are marked as measured, estimates as estimates.
- No personal or client data; cases are published only with the consent of whoever needs to agree.
- Every contribution counts, online or offline, recognised with badges, not points or rankings. Members choose up to five badges to show.
- Run by a small management team; being on it is a responsibility, not a power.

## How to join or contribute
First contributions: recommend an interview guest, report a wall you hit, write or fix a case, recommend an article for a reading session, translate a case summary.
